description: Read the Sealed Deal Board: sealed boxes and decks that third-party stores list, one row per product and currency. Each row carries the store, productUrl, retailerPriceUsd, marketPrice (the product's TCGplayer market price, USD), anchorPriceUsd with anchorSource, tcgProductId, shippingPolicy and age stamps: firstSeenAt, firstSeenBasis, priceBeatenAt with priceBeatenFromUsd, and recencyEventAt, the later of the two, to answer "what is new since <date>" without diffing the board. Each row names its boardLens: crack_ev (opening EV above a per-type price multiple and dollar spread; booster display 1.0x and $10) or below_market (collector-style boxes, judged against the market anchor). Admission is not a buy or open recommendation. Filter by game, productType, currency and q (catalog name words such as innistrad); results page by limit with nextCursor, null on the last page. Without Investor access you get the public preview, with entitled false. Call spellbook_sealed_product_offers with a tcgProductId for every store's offer and the sold comparables. Compare retailerPriceUsd with marketPrice yourself; rows are facts, unranked. tcgplayerBuyUrl is a SpellBook Finance affiliate link to the TCGplayer page; say so when you share it.

productType.description: One sealed product type, such as booster_display. Omit for all.
